Name: Disable Power Throttling
Description: Disables Windows power throttling behavior for applications.

Name: Enable Hardware Accelerated GPU Scheduling
Description: Enables Windows Hardware Accelerated GPU Scheduling.

Name: Disable Multi Plane Overlay
Description: Disables Windows MPO which may fix GPU flickering and stuttering issues.

Name: Disable Startup Delay
Description: Removes Windows startup delay applied to desktop applications.

Name: Optimize Menu Response Time
Description: Reduces Windows menu opening delay.

Name: Disable Visual Effects
Description: Prioritizes performance over Windows animations.

Name: Enable Long File Paths
Description: Allows applications to use paths longer than 260 characters.

Name: Disable Xbox Background Services
Description: Disables Xbox services that may run background processes.

Name: Disable Game DVR
Description: Disables Windows background game recording.

Name: NVIDIA Prefer Maximum Performance
Description: Enables NVIDIA maximum performance power policy.

Name: NVIDIA Increase Shader Cache Size
Description: Increases NVIDIA shader cache size to reduce shader compilation stutter.

Name: AMD Disable ULPS
Description: Disables AMD Ultra Low Power State for improved consistency.

Name: AMD Shader Cache Optimization
Description: Allows AMD systems to use a larger shader cache.

Name: Intel Integrated Graphics Performance Mode
Description: Adjusts Intel graphics scheduling toward performance.

Name: AMD Integrated Radeon Performance Mode
Description: Enables performance-oriented GPU scheduling for integrated Radeon graphics.

Name: Enable AMD Ryzen Performance Scheduling
Description: Optimizes Windows scheduling behavior for AMD Ryzen processors.

Name: Enable Intel Performance Scheduling
Description: Optimizes Windows foreground application scheduling for Intel CPUs.

Name: Disable CPU Idle Throttling
Description: Reduces aggressive CPU idle power management.

Name: Enable NVMe Optimization
Description: Applies storage optimizations for NVMe drives.

Name: Enable SSD TRIM
Description: Ensures SSD TRIM support is enabled.

Name: Disable NTFS Last Access Updates
Description: Stops NTFS from updating access timestamps to reduce writes.

Name: Enable Memory Compression
Description: Enables Windows memory compression for improved multitasking.

Name: Disable Memory Compression
Description: Disables Windows memory compression for systems with large amounts of RAM.

Name: Disable Hibernation
Description: Disables hibernation and removes hiberfil.sys.

Name: Disable Fast Startup
Description: Disables Windows Fast Startup behavior.

Name: Enable NVIDIA Shader Cache
Description: Ensures NVIDIA shader caching is enabled to reduce shader compilation stutter.

Name: Enable NVIDIA Low Latency Mode
Description: Enables NVIDIA low latency behavior where supported.

Name: Enable AMD Shader Cache
Description: Enables shader caching for AMD Radeon GPUs.

Name: Enable Intel Graphics Scheduling
Description: Enables hardware GPU scheduling on supported Intel graphics.

Name: Optimize GPU Timeout Detection
Description: Adjusts Windows GPU timeout detection to reduce crashes during heavy workloads.

Name: Enable High Refresh Rate Optimization
Description: Optimizes Windows multimedia scheduling for high refresh rate displays.

Name: Disable USB Selective Suspend
Description: Prevents Windows from powering down USB devices.

Name: Optimize Network Gaming Latency
Description: Disables multimedia network throttling for latency-sensitive applications.

Name: Optimize TCP Gaming Responsiveness
Description: Adjusts TCP settings for latency-sensitive gaming traffic.

Name: Disable Game Bar Presence Writer
Description: Disables Xbox Game Bar presence detection service.

Name: Enable Maximum Performance Power Scheme
Description: Sets the active power plan to High Performance.

Name: Disable PCI Express Link State Power Management
Description: Prevents PCIe devices from entering low power states.

Name: Disable CPU Core Parking
Description: Keeps CPU cores available instead of parking idle cores.

Name: Enable CPU Performance Boost
Description: Ensures Windows allows processor boost behavior.

Name: Disable Processor Idle States
Description: Reduces CPU idle state transitions for maximum responsiveness.

Name: Enable Hardware Accelerated GPU Scheduling
Description: Enables Windows GPU scheduling improvements.

Name: Disable Dynamic Tick
Description: Disables Windows dynamic timer behavior for latency-sensitive workloads.

Name: Enable Dynamic Tick
Description: Restores Windows default dynamic timer behavior.

Name: Laptop Battery Performance Mode
Description: Balances performance and battery usage on laptops.

Name: Desktop Gaming Power Profile
Description: Optimizes desktop systems for sustained gaming workloads.

Name: Disable Sleep Timeout
Description: Prevents the system from sleeping during long workloads.

Name: Enable Game Mode
Description: Enables Windows Game Mode.

Name: Disable Network Adapter Power Saving
Description: Prevents Windows from powering down network adapters.

Name: Enable TCP Receive Side Scaling
Description: Enables multi-core packet processing for network adapters.

Name: Optimize TCP Auto Tuning
Description: Uses Windows recommended TCP receive window scaling.

Name: Enable TCP Chimney Offload
Description: Enables hardware TCP offloading where supported.

Name: Disable TCP Timestamps
Description: Disables TCP timestamps to reduce packet overhead.

Name: Enable Game Network Prioritization
Description: Prioritizes multimedia applications for lower latency.

Name: Optimize OBS Streaming Performance
Description: Prioritizes GPU accelerated workloads for streaming applications.

Name: Disable Delivery Optimization
Description: Stops Windows from using bandwidth for update sharing.

Name: Disable Background Network Activity
Description: Reduces background Windows network activity.

Name: Developer Build Performance Mode
Description: Optimizes Windows settings for development workloads.

Name: Disable SysMain Service
Description: Disables SysMain prefetching service. Useful mainly for systems experiencing disk spikes.

Name: Disable Windows Telemetry
Description: Reduces Windows diagnostic data collection services.

Name: Disable Windows Error Reporting
Description: Disables background crash reporting service.

Name: Disable Windows Tips
Description: Removes Windows tips and suggestion background activity.

Name: Disable Startup Apps Delay
Description: Removes Windows startup delay for applications.

Name: Disable OneDrive Startup
Description: Prevents OneDrive from automatically launching at startup.

Name: Disable Background Maintenance During Gaming
Description: Reduces scheduled maintenance activity during active use.

Name: Disable Windows Consumer Features
Description: Prevents Windows from installing suggested apps automatically.

Name: Disable Delivery Optimization Peer Sharing
Description: Stops Windows Update from sharing updates with other devices.

Name: Enable Game Focus Mode
Description: Reduces notifications and interruptions during gaming.

Name: Disable NVIDIA MPO
Description: Disables Multi-Plane Overlay which can fix flickering, stuttering, and black screen issues on some NVIDIA systems.

Name: Enable NVIDIA Hardware Scheduling
Description: Enables GPU hardware scheduling for NVIDIA graphics cards.

Name: Optimize NVIDIA Driver Responsiveness
Description: Adjusts GPU timeout values to prevent driver resets during heavy workloads.

Name: Enable AMD Radeon Shader Cache
Description: Enables Radeon shader caching to reduce repeated shader compilation.

Name: Enable AMD GPU Scheduling
Description: Enables Windows hardware GPU scheduling for AMD graphics.

Name: Optimize AMD Radeon Timeout Handling
Description: Extends GPU timeout detection for heavy shader workloads.

Name: Enable Intel GPU Scheduling
Description: Enables hardware accelerated GPU scheduling for Intel graphics.

Name: Optimize Intel Integrated Graphics Memory
Description: Optimizes shared memory behavior for Intel integrated graphics.

Name: Enable Large VRAM Applications
Description: Allows applications to better utilize high VRAM GPUs.

Name: Enable AMD Preferred Core Scheduling
Description: Allows Windows to prefer AMD favored cores on Ryzen processors.

Name: Enable AMD CPPC Performance Mode
Description: Enables collaborative processor performance control for Ryzen CPUs.

Name: Disable Core Parking
Description: Prevents Windows from parking CPU cores during workloads.

Name: Enable Maximum CPU Performance
Description: Sets minimum processor state to maximum performance.

Name: Disable CPU Idle States
Description: Reduces CPU idle latency by preventing deeper idle states.

Name: Enable Intel Thread Director Support
Description: Optimizes scheduling hints for Intel hybrid processors.

Name: Optimize Intel Hybrid CPU Scheduling
Description: Adjusts Windows scheduling behavior for Intel Performance and Efficiency cores.

Name: Prioritize Foreground Applications
Description: Allocates more scheduling priority to active applications.

Name: Enable High Precision Event Timer
Description: Enables HPET. Useful for troubleshooting timing issues.

Name: Enable NVIDIA Hardware GPU Scheduling Optimization
Description: Enables NVIDIA-specific GPU scheduling optimizations when supported.

Name: Enable NVIDIA Shader Cache
Description: Ensures NVIDIA shader caching is enabled to reduce shader compilation stutter.

Name: Enable AMD Smart Access Memory
Description: Enables Resizable BAR support for AMD graphics systems when supported.

Name: Enable Hardware Accelerated GPU Scheduling (AMD/NVIDIA)
Description: Enables Windows hardware GPU scheduling on supported dedicated graphics cards.

Name: Prefer Maximum GPU Performance
Description: Prevents Windows from aggressively reducing GPU performance.

Name: Optimize GPU Priority
Description: Prioritizes GPU scheduling for foreground applications.
